holdout_card.fact_statement: The Long March to Dhaka was organized by protesters to force Sheikh Hasina out of power.
holdout_card.source_span: === Long March to Dhaka === Asif Mahmud, a coordinator of the Students Against Discrimination, announced that their march to Dhaka had been rescheduled to 5 August
